title: feat(configure): getRenderState for multiple configure widgets

comments.body:

Latest deployment of this branch, based on commit 1accd9d9722baaa8045a920ef52510259b6bdab8:

|Sandbox| Source |
|--|--|
|[InstantSearch.js](https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-ckkpo)| Configuration |

All in all, I feel like this explores all the options, meaning that if someone really requires this, they would need to fork connectConfigure, and add a feature very similar to this PR, but that we shouldn't merge it as-is and rather keep the last added configure widget as the only renderState

The way that I saw this was that we don't need identifiers. At the end of the day, with the Configure render state, you want to know what are _all_ the search parameters that it applied.

So I think it's fine to merge all the Configure render state properties in there—with a priority to the last props if duplicated, just like how `searchParameters` are sent to Algolia.

Wdyt?
ah yes good idea, we can merge all searchParameters. Thanks for the idea @francoischalifour
